notes.title: Farming Simulator 25 - it's coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/e6d44c0b514ac6cc40ecedffceeb3c374a42b0d1.png[/img]

We'll flood the fields with fresh water to grow rice, unleash new machines, and create more depth - in more ways than one. While you may have many questions, how about we give you the answer for 'FS25 when' first?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/41733e1479986157fdfc2a5e4a4b83fb1c69a12e.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2300320/Farming_Simulator_25/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/dab6f782bae87be6f2acc639541d6c4903237303.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=8MlSiOBNSSs;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/dab6f782bae87be6f2acc639541d6c4903237303.png[/img]

[h2]You Want Even More?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/7d5f7dc03bf1a805d47695d23a78f890c7625dc8.png[/img]

Year 1 Bundle contains Farming Simulator 25 + Year 1 Season Pass (3 content packs & 1 expansion) to extend to your game as soon as the additional content releases. 
By pre-ordering (all versions), you get the MacDon Pack with five highlight machines on top!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/fb5c299d1a26fb658efd598142e592913c1f4256.png[/img]

[h2]Farm In Asia![/h2]
[h3]There are Buffalos, too...[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/dab6f782bae87be6f2acc639541d6c4903237303.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/f8123aedef073e30ba8cc4612e4d5460c6f34287.jpg[/img]

Want to embark on a new farming challenge in a lush East Asian landscape filled with rice paddies? Do that! Build an agricultural empire in a North American environment with plenty of open space? Go ahead! Enjoy a scenic Central European location with green fields between ponds and rivers? Build your dream farm right there! Farming Simulator 25 features three diverse environments for your farming venture.

 
[h2]Grow Rice! [/h2]
[h3]And Flood the Fields with Water...[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/dab6f782bae87be6f2acc639541d6c4903237303.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/01d443bd01e0245d4247f0ed4522b2598769862e.jpg[/img]

Grow two types of rice, spinach, and other new crops - choosing from well over 20 overall. Mighty buffalos and other animals join cows, sheep, pigs, chickens, horses, and other livestock, while new production chains and construction missions extend your business opportunities. 

 
[h2]More Machines[/h2]
[h3]From Your Favorite Brands[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/dab6f782bae87be6f2acc639541d6c4903237303.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/2d121a866dd955da1f13ce76160a3495a88cb03e.jpg[/img]

Over 400 authentic machines & items from more than 150 international top brands like Case IH, CLAAS, Fendt, John Deere, Kubota, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra, and many more allow you to engage in agriculture, forestry, and animal husbandry. Whether you build your legacy single-handedly or cooperatively in multiplayer - you decide!

 
[h2]Upgrading Fields & Visuals[/h2]
[h3]GIANTS Engine 10[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/dab6f782bae87be6f2acc639541d6c4903237303.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/c74c588faa186567d4ce3228588ce123c66d9eef.jpg[/img]

Feel a deeper connection to your fields and nature thanks to a general tech upgrade with improved graphics and physics based on the latest and modding-friendly GIANTS Engine 10. Including distance fog, enhanced shadows, dynamic weather effects, ground deformation, and more. The romantic life of virtual farming gets more immersive and atmospheric!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/dab6f782bae87be6f2acc639541d6c4903237303.png[/img]

[h1]More reveals & details coming soon![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/dab6f782bae87be6f2acc639541d6c4903237303.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/fb69c726912505ed3ae8c97e5630293dec01ccb4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/38d86fede09f0206577e48afcad364dc03d44b50.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/859d658f3d182e082df6cb5ec76518ec7b85b3ca.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/dab6f782bae87be6f2acc639541d6c4903237303.png[/img]

[h1]How about visiting FarmCon?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45074709/dab6f782bae87be6f2acc639541d6c4903237303.png[/img]

On July 6th & 7th, we invite you to our annual community convention at the Fendt Forum in the Bavarian town Marktoberdorf (Germany). You might want to be there and learn more about Farming Simulator 25! We have an exciting stage program and more planned for you.
[url=https://www.farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=518]Need more information about FarmCon 24?[/url]

notes.title: Farm Production Pack Available Now!
notes.content:
Make your farming operation smoother and more sustainable! The Farm Production Pack by Design, Modeling & Innovation (DMI - formerly known as Dutch Modding Incorporated) & GIANTS Software, is now available for PC and consoles! 

[previewyoutube=VrtIdksL8-c;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2834020/Farming_Simulator_22__Farm_Production_Pack/


[h2]For Growing Businesses & Big Operations[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/04856231e42c8fbbfbb52de95139d6fc822ff7b5.jpg[/img]

Get over 20 new machines, buildings, and selling points in the Farm Production Pack! Whether you're starting small or growing a thriving empire, this pack offers content for every stage of your agricultural operation.

Begin with newer, more affordable wind turbines or invest in solar panels, complete with a robot for remote cleaning. Generate passive income and use it to build customizable sheds for storing equipment and materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/8b648571502c313a373dff610434b701a965a988.jpg[/img]

As your farm expands, new selling points with dynamic prices and daily demands, including vending machines, market stalls, a supermarket, and a farm store, add a new layer of depth to the gameplay. Fast deliveries to these locations are rewarded with bonuses.


[h2]New Playthings - including a Distribution Center![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/667dd055e567076729ba7a2c5a98826f756fdccb.jpg[/img]

Among the new machines for your farm: the Lely Sphere! Utilize it to create liquid fertilizer from manure and air from animal sheds, making your farm more eco-friendly. Boost crop yields with VDW's Cleaner Tiger, which cleans and cuts sugar beets, and a washing drum that produces washed crops for higher prices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/f00a3c814c45686dc4bda406fd4edd450be97b7c.jpg[/img]

With a sustainable farm and market demands met, set your sights on managing a distribution center. Covering 4,000 square meters, this endgame feature allows you to operate forklifts, manage high-load shelves, and distribute goods on a large scale. What could be more rewarding in the end, huh?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2834020/Farming_Simulator_22__Farm_Production_Pack/

notes.title: Free Straw Harvest Pack Now Available
notes.content:
Straw Harvest is now available for Farming Simulator 22! Extend your agricultural operation with the pellet industry and increase straw-based productivity.  With the updated version, you can also look forward to improved visuals and details of the acclaimed expansion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/73e47acd79b8939e905ea001cd53cb1cf221a7da.png[/img]

The free Straw Harvest Pack by studio Creative Mesh brings you specialized machines, tools, and other resources. It’s available on PC and consoles, free of charge, directly via the in-game ModHub. 
[h2]Adding Brands & Machines[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/0529850132848a108c49d7c40d4b1943b4d6dc1a.png[/img]

Look forward to powerful machinery from manufacturers KRONE and Bressel und Lade. One of the highlight machines is the world's first mobile pellet harvester – the KRONE Premos 5000, which produces pellets by collecting straw and hay swaths from the field. Alternatively, it can be operated stationary with an additional bale shredder.

Also included are two balers, the KRONE BiG Pack 1290 HDP II and Comprima V180 XC alongside other machines for handling bales and pallets.
[h2]Industry-Based Gameplay[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/55db28690a48c4e702f3d178c0724586dd775963.png[/img]

To add another layer to the gameplay, a versatile and configurable industry hall allows for storage and processing. While produced pellets can be sold, used for animal bedding, or fed to animals, the industry allows more possibilities through configurations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/363b3cf84f79b80351827a0dba818206934df665.png[/img]

Use it as an empty hall for parking vehicles as well as storing bales and pallets, or add a hall crane for easier moving of bulk material, bales, and pallets. Adding an automatic palletizer, further processed pellets can be sold at an even higher profit.

notes.title: AMD FSR 3 + Frame Generation Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/3adcd9913217701c68e54260a48bacde61947e2f.jpg[/img]

Farming Simulator 22 now supports AMD FSR 3 on PC, so you can enjoy even smoother farming. Download game update 1.13.1.1, and activate FSR plus Frame Generation to boost your frame rate on supported graphics cards!


[h2]Wait, what's FSR?[/h2]

AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution (in short: AMD FSR) uses upscaling technologies that aim to increase the frame rate. In simplified terms, it first renders Farming Simulator 22 at a lower resolution, but then upscales it using a variety of (very smart & efficient) techniques.

Without sacrificing image quality, you can significantly increase the performance of Farming Simulator 22, especially when demanding settings are enabled. Try it!


[h2]What's new in FSR 3?[/h2]

AMD FSR 3 improves upon FSR 2’s upscaling and adds Frame Generation. This feature can be activated separately in the graphics settings of Farming Simulator 22. It generates additional frames to increase the frame rate. 

Imagine one new frame being inserted in between two existing frames. In some, ideal situations, depending on your hardware and individual settings, FSR 3 with activated Frame Generation can straight up double your displayed fps to guarantee some extra-smooth farming!

[u]Please note: AMD FSR 3 Frame Generation is recommended to be used with a minimum of 60 fps before FG-activation![/u]

[h2]Does that work with my graphics card?[/h2]

FSR is open-source, based on industry standards, and doesn't require a specialized graphics card. It doesn't even need to be an AMD card! So, it can work on newer as well as older GPUs to improve your virtual farming experience. Check for [url=https://www.amd.com/en/technologies/fidelityfx-super-resolution#Details]supported GPUs[/url] on the AMD page.

FSR works only in supported games, and Farming Simulator 22 is one of them. More than that, it is one of the first games to have supported the initial implementation as well as the updated FSR 3 that introduces frame generation. 

[h2]Need more details?[/h2]

Find some [url=https://www.amd.com/de/technologies/fidelityfx-super-resolution]general information about FSR 3[/url] on the official info AMD website. If you want to go further and deep-dive into the [url=https://gpuopen.com/fsr3-in-games-technical-details/]technical background of AMD FSR 3 and Frame Generation[/url], you also can find more details on AMD.com.

notes.title: Premium Expansion & Edition Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/e7c182676d307c8d8a8063e933dc4a931215f8b4.jpg[/img]
A premium-amount of new content marks the best time to start farming or return to the fields with more machines, maps, and crops than ever: The Premium Expansion and Premium Edition of Farming Simulator 22 are now available on PC & consoles! Here's the Launch Trailer:

[previewyoutube=MJPzT4AAlf4;full]{youtube:MJPzT4AAlf4}[/previewyoutube]

[h2]Edition: One Game, Two Expansions, Seven Packs [/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/c5021ad2175b23826c7c435cdb5ee16d19021a68.jpg[/img]

The Premium Edition is a comprehensive package full of content: it includes Farming Simulator 22, six maps, seven official content packs, and both expansions of Year 1 & Year 2. Included are the Antonio Carraro Pack, Kubota Pack, Vermeer Pack, Göweil Pack, Hay & Forage Pack, Horsch AgroVation Pack & Oxbo Pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/ed6e5d4ac60365e41c97ccca4259eb16e80d3308.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, it contains the Premium Expansion (also available separately) and the forestry-focused Platinum Expansion that introduced Volvo to the series and featured many other brands, gameplay mechanics, a new map, and more. All in all, you get hundreds of machines from more than 150 brands to operate. 


[h2]Expansion: New Map, Crops & Machines[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/54144d42b19a09b152c16c05027779a81673ef70.jpg[/img]

Zielonka expresses the flair of Germany’s neighbors, drawing inspiration from countries like Poland and the Czech Republic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/7a6884731112d70d606feddbd919b70814a2b647.jpg[/img]

The picturesque landscape around a remote village offers fertile soil to cultivate the new vegetable crops: carrots, parsnips & red beet - which are added to the list of overall 20 crops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/342fb34519116cbfe8c9a3506a8c370d67209da0.jpg[/img]

There are also new factories, and production chains (soup factory, preserved food factory & potato processing plant) as well as a construction project that needs you to deliver wooden planks for the fancy production of pianos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/cd9debb1d49e08fee26715a7063642d5cb5f2b43.jpg[/img]

More than 35 new vehicles and tools are included: Authentically digitized with more details than ever, the implements extend the fleet to care for new as well as existing crops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/ae7ca0bf333cc9c138b9ffcbd397c0a23779fa14.jpg[/img]

That includes ridge formers to shape ridges before sowing the new crops. Find out more about the process to sow & harvest carrots, parsnips, and red beet in our [url=newsArticle.php?&news_id=280]Farming Simulator Academy Tutorials[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/4eec9e4110b7fdda2148c78a063db81a85f2a24b.jpg[/img]

Manufacturers Dewulf, Gorenc, Agrio & WIFO debut in the series, with even more machines by BEDNAR, Fiat, GRIMME, Kverneland, SaMASZ & others.


[h2]Which version to get?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/1a68f0cf547712ce9bbd3abdc0064f472e91f1c0.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Get the Premium Edition if ...[/u][/b]

... you don't own Farming Simulator 22 or the variety of packs and expansions. The comprehensive Premium Edition is the best-value option. It contains the base-game + all packs and expansions of the Year 1 Season Pass & Year 2 Season Pass, including the brand-new Premium Expansion.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33022/Farming_Simulator_22_Premium_Edition/

[b][u]Get the Premium Expansion if ...[/u][/b]

... you already own the base-game and previous content packs + expansions, or only want to get the Premium Expansion content for Farming Simulator 22 separately. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243200/Farming_Simulator_22__Premium_Expansion/

[b][u]Is the Premium Expansion included in the Season Pass?[/u][/b]

The Premium Expansion is part of the Year 2 Season Pass for Farming Simulator 22. You don't have to purchase the Premium Expansion if you already own this season pass.

[h2][b][u]New To The Game?[/u][/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/d2032cf9d2d26d270ebefa1bb650f9cfdb8f3bf0.jpg[/img]

If you require some help in starting out - visit our Farming Simulator Academy! Find official tutorials, made by our games experts themselves, that will help you learn the game - with more and more topics being added over time. Check it out!

https://www.farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?&news_id=280


Don't miss any Farming Simulator news! Stay tuned and keep an eye on our channels: We're on [url=https://discord.com/invite/giantssoftware]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/giants.farming.simulator]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/farmingsim]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/farmingsimulator/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCOmANDuJs2IHiEq8p9Ll5tw]YouTube,[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@farmingsimulator]TikTok[/url].

notes.title: Case IH Farmall Anniversary Pack Now Available!
notes.content:
Here's a new pack, available now! Celebrating the 100th Anniversary of Farmall, you get two iconic Farmall series tractors by Case IH from two exciting eras of agriculture. Authentically digitized for Farming Simulator 22 with the Case IH Farmall Anniversary Pack. 

[previewyoutube=o7ZNN7GbZSM;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620980


[h2]Case IH Farmall 1066 Hydro[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/132444ab1f1da2ce5c6a67229e710f68fc89b6e8.jpg[/img]

Manufactured between 1971 and 1976 by International Harvester, this classic six-cylinder diesel tractor remains significantly popular among farmers today, much as it was over half a century ago.

It's a tractor that many farmers grew up with, and a piece of machinery that feels as vibrant in their memories as the fresh red paint on a well-preserved Case IH Farmall 1066 Hydro. Its enduring legacy continues in Farming Simulator 22.


[h2]Case IH Farmall C Series[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/d1b83ac4f0fdcba049c31ae9ccdc257fc7286f5c.jpg[/img]

A reliable and proven workhorse: No matter the field of application, the red multi-talent of the Farmall C series by Case IH offers up to 120 hp!

That’s why the Case IH Farmall 120C is a popular choice among farmers when it comes to grassland farming, intensive field activities or heavy loader tasks. It’s a versatile premium all-rounder, on real and virtual farms!

notes.title: Free Emergency Pack Now Available for PC & Consoles
notes.content:
Attention, farmers! There’s an emergency, and you, as an engaged resident, can lend a hand to your fellow neighbors. You just have to install the Emergency Pack. It's free, it's on ModHub, it's available now - on PC and consoles. Check out the Launch Trailer!

[previewyoutube=HcKap_JTmcc;full]HcKap_JTmcc[/previewyoutube]


[h2]Respond to Emergencies![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/3f719ffd618c723785c81d5c1c1162cfd3eec3da.jpg[/img]

Developed by Creative Mesh, makers of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052720/Farming_Simulator_22__Pumps_n_Hoses_Pack/]Pumps N' Hoses[/url] and Straw Harvest, the Emergency Pack offers you ten emergencies from four different scenarios that occur on and around local farmlands. When the pager starts to beep, you dispatch with two multifunctional firetrucks and a variety of professional tools to rush to the scene. 


[h2]Fight Fires, Rescue People - and Cats![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/7e89cb61328db7126f32fac0e360f87200be5745.jpg[/img]

Your responsibilities as a firefighter include, well... firefighting, of course, as well as mitigation of hazardous, obstructive materials on the road (like trees or oil spills), and technical rescue of injured passengers in a car crash. More than that, a good firefighter also responds to helpless kittens stuck in trees. So, put up a ladder and save the cat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/b171df81046b2d239c44040d57d6a49d513ef609.jpg[/img]

When it comes to fires in the area, extinguish rising flames by hand or from the safety of the fire truck. Pallets, containers, bales, or fields catch on fire from time to time (change the frequency of occurrence in the settings). When oil is spilled, fallen trees block the road, or a car crash occurred, you have to secure the area, first.  


[h2]Specialized Firetrucks & Tools[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/74a2b7eedabbc4885ce503d12589a704beb37fd4.jpg[/img]

You can't dispatch to emergencies without proper vehicles and tools, can you? Included in the Emergency Pack are the authentically digitized HLF20 and TLF3000 firetrucks by German manufacturer Schlingmann. With specialized tools, you eliminate dangerous materials or obstacles and cut free passengers trapped in automobiles.

Need reinforcements? Play the Emergency Pack with your friends, as the trucks can seat up to nine virtual firefighters and volunteers (multi-passenger script of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1988850/Farming_Simulator_22__Kubota_Pack/]Kubota Pack[/url] required). And if those ten missions are not enough, additional scenarios can be created via mods, allowing you to create your own missions.

notes.title: Patch 1.13.1 Now Available For Farming Simulator 22!
notes.content:
[i][b]Please Note![/b] The patch is currently being rolled out across platforms. It can take a couple of hours until the update becomes available on your system. Crossplay services may be affected in the meantime.[/i]

notes.title: Premium Expansion Preview: Red Beet
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1248130/announcements/detail/7282941875937837945]Carrots[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1248130/announcements/detail/3709336113884476494]parsnips[/url], and red beet com with the Premium Expansion for Farming Simulator 22 on November 14th. We already previewed the former two crops, and if you missed it, click the links to catch up! Let's continue with red beet and take a look at the third new crop type. 


[h2]Crop Type Info: Red Beet[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/615fd19e2908a8630ee9351d3df623df0e11ebcc.jpg[/img]

Red beet (also known as beetroot) is a root vegetable you can instantly identify by its vibrant crimson color. If you taste it, by the earthy, sweet flavor. Red beet is enjoyed both raw and cooked in various culinary dishes, and it's what gives Red Velvet Cakes their distinct red color!

The crop is rich in essential nutrients, including fiber, vitamins, and minerals. That's why it's often used as a nutritious addition to salads, soups, and a variety of side dishes. Juice, too. It's healthy and provides antioxidants. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/802f7601a25a13e27ed7822e26eab5f54d228486.jpg[/img]


[h3][u]Cooking with red beet - how about burgers?[/u][/h3]

[u]Here are some dishes you can try with red beet as a main ingredient: red beet salad, red beet risotto, red beet carpaccio, or red beet hummus! How about vegetarian red beet burgers, even?[/u]

[u]Grate peeled beets, onion, and garlic in a large mixing bowl, add olive oil, eggs, and rolled oats or something with a similar texture, and after the oats soaked up the liquids, you season the mixture with salt and pepper, or whatever spices you see fit. Now, you can shape patties with your hands and fry them in the pan. It's easy, red, and delicious. [/u]


[h2]Red Beet: Machines To Plant & Harvest[/h2]

Similar to carrots and parsnips, red beet profit from you using the new field working step to create ridges before sowing. Apart from that, the process should feel familiar:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/34efee9e13172d1776d36ebe897e13b46c0d1c1d.jpg[/img]

After plowing the field, and before sowing red beet, you create ridges using ridge formers (or 'rotary hillers'). This improves your yield, and counts towards the full stage of fertilization. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/48b0d3c72eda6c40a4ef53146fb13c676f612dae.jpg[/img]

Not just the ridge formers like the GRIMME GF 400 & 800 are new with the Premium Expansion. We add seeders like the Kverneland Miniair Nova series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/5feabebc1620d47030507800f0fec4f4f672c735.jpg[/img]

You can choose from different sizes of harvesters: Operate the Dewulf ZKIVSE, a self-propelled 4-row top lifting harvester with discharge elevator (shown here while harvesting carrots) ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/673bd702fd566695b1ecd6faf2a4c72199990abc.jpg[/img]

... or a smaller, more affordable and trailed top lifting harvester like the Dewulf GBC. There's a harvester for every farming operation and their financial situation. Don't forget, that you can lease them, if you just want to try them out!

Want to see a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1248130/announcements/detail/3681182908892149625]list of all machines included in the Premium Expansion[/url]? Head over to the linked article or straight to the shop page! You can still pre-order and save 10%.

notes.title: Parsnips & Pianos: Map Trailer for Zielonka + Download Poster!
notes.content:
The second big expansion for Farming Simulator 22 lets you cultivate an agricultural empire in Zielonka - a brand-new Central European map coming with the Premium Expansion. Looking ahead to the scheduled release on November 14th, we set the mood right now: Check out the map trailer below and check out Zielonka!

[previewyoutube=STa2h-NJbDs;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]The Charm of Central European Farming[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/e601414607249512809a302fba3cb139ef6e40d3.jpg[/img]

Zielonka expresses the flair of Germany’s neighbors, drawing inspiration from countries like Poland and the Czech Republic. Not only does it offer a picturesque landscape around a remote and quaint village, it also has fertile ground to cultivate the new vegetable crops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/f1b74f64faffe25c03aed007ee20e3100a43bdb7.jpg[/img]

With carrots, parsnips, and red beet, the Premium Expansion brings the total count of arable crops in Farming Simulator 22 to twenty. Of course, new machines and tools like specialized harvesters to handle the additions become available with the expansion, too.


[h2]Home of Pianos & Vegetable Exports[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/d910a35ae412759c30e88b6e7a44834160464804.jpg[/img]

Above all, a renowned piano manufacturer is resident alongside other traditional businesses in Zielonka. You may profit heavily from supporting the construction of classical keyboard instruments: By supplying wood, every piano built becomes a source of revenue for the discerning farmer. Have fun with this new production chain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/342fb34519116cbfe8c9a3506a8c370d67209da0.jpg[/img]

There are new factories, too: Focusing on vegetables, the potato production plant produces crispy potato chips, the preserved food factory canned goods, while the beloved soup factory called “Zup, Zup, Zup” specializes in liquid food. All of them reward you with increased income for delivering produce.

[url=https://files.giants-software.com/file/bedf364a619209370183b629436658ab]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/53df80a6c7a27379e603edaf51e9db6a518a3a10.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Oxbo Pack Now Available For PC & Consoles!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/c50d172d915c52cfaab87b17047d3644595d118a.jpg[/img]

With the Oxbo Pack, we have now released the fourth and final pack in the second year of Farming Simulator 22 (but, don't forget the expansion coming in November)!

It offers a variety of cool new machines by the renowned international manufacturer and lets you optimize your farming operations with handy new machinery. If you got the Year 2 Season Pass, you're covered, of course!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243190/?snr=1_5_9__205

[h2]Harvester, Applicator, Merger[/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/5c9e13c3a9b4bf20604bcc83a636f54f40d09ae2.jpg[/img]

Visually impressive and fun to operate, the Oxbo 6030 is definitely the highlight of the pack - a configurable multi-function grape harvester & sprayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/d600e3116e8716d931c4d6063b92887bc59755fd.jpg[/img]

Meanwhile, the three-wheeled and sharp-turning Oxbo AT4103 & AT5105 applicators for manure and slurry application offer highly maneuverable steering and high capacity  - thanks to their big tanks, which come in handy on your fields.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/9360ccbc62969ffbcaca5879a65e4fc7ac12a22d.jpg[/img]

Since Oxbo is a pioneer when it comes to the triple merger concept, you also get the Oxbo 2340 forage merger. It comes with a 12-meter working width for increased productivity of forage production.

notes.title: Dig the soil with HORSCH AgroVation Pack - Now Available!
notes.content:
To forget how to dig the earth and to tend the soil is to forget ourselves. A wisdom whose motto HORSCH lives by with its philosophy of gentle soil cultivation. And you can, too - in game: Including a new map and new machines, the HORSCH AgroVation Pack is now available for Farming Simulator 22. Patch 1.11 is also available for download - so, update your game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243180/Farming_Simulator_22__HORSCH_AgroVation_Pack/


[h2]New Map: HORSCH AgroVation Farm[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/7c21503bb74dfe6c41020117051621a9302b07ef.jpg[/img]

Faithfully recreated environment from the real world: The HORSCH AgroVation farm located in Kněžmost, Czech Republic, is available for you as a playable map. Here, you have the freedom to create your own ideas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/5220334c373b869e71bf8d4eaa691893cb9bdb2d.jpg[/img]

The farm layout with its small to large fields and various storage buildings was digitized for Farming Simulator 22 and equips you with a fleet of brand-new HORSCH machines that debut in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/7c0b2e589c5e0ef32a05140d3beee9a267dae477.jpg[/img]

It features efficient high-performance machines like the Maestro 24.50 SV precision planter and the Avatar 12.25 D seed drill, the Cura 24 ST weeder, or the Cultro 12 TC mulcher, and Transformer 12 VF hoe. notes.title: New Multiplayer Modes Now Available on PC & Consoles!
notes.content:
Ready for some field action? Our new competitive multiplayer modes are now available in Farming Simulator 22. Download patch 1.10, and you'll find both the Bale Stacking Mode and the Arena Mode in the main menu under "esports" - check it out!

[previewyoutube=_p-q5s2dsNA;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Stacking Bales for the Highscore[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/406149aec77aa8a40ea54b2a8cdb8d8f548b5815.jpg[/img]

What started out as a joyful highlight on international gaming events a few years ago, is now playable at home with up to six players: The Bale Stacking Mode requires you to carefully (and more important: quickly) stack square bales onto a trailer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/c709bf196a80d3224fad461eef3eb5b9bf243330.jpg[/img]

The goal: beat your own or your friend's highscore while a countdown applies some pressure! It's always good to train your skills for operating a front loader attached to your tractor anyway - even for your day-to-day farming business (hint: might be a helpful skill for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243170/Farming_Simulator_22__Hay__Forage_Pack/]upcoming Hay & Forage Pack[/url]).


[h2]Team-Based Arena Mode Requires Strategy[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/3d71279b49e36e20061e1d301b12a0ade4a84880.jpg[/img]

Known from the FSL, the Arena Mode is now open to everyone. You don't need to register or compete in the league (but you can). Two teams, consisting of up to three players each, compete for the highscore by harvesting wheat, pressing bales and delivering them to their barn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/2d57fc89c22505ac5fe6bb3f48d2394494af3a1c.jpg[/img]

Additional layers of tactical gameplay are ensured through a pick & ban phase, randomized power-ups and multiple strategic approaches possible. There’s also a training mode to make it easy for everyone to check it out - you can even try it on your own if you're not ready for others.


[h2]Want To Go Professional? Join The FSL![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/70b2d60812f0fc2f48b7a46a166dd24309859555.jpg[/img]

You probably know the Arena Mode from the [url=https://fsl.giants-software.com/]Farming Simulator League[/url] already. If you're interested in competing on a professional level, check out the website for the FSL, where you and your friends can register and join the league. 

Season 5 (with a prize pool worth 200,000 Euros!) starts on July 1st & 2nd at FarmCon 23 in Lauingen, Germany. Might be worthwhile to start training with the new multiplayer modes - so, grab some friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/2d70e65673785586577c7a3c3cbf6256e8ebb63b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hay & Forage Pack Coming Soon - Pre-Order Now!
notes.content:
With the warm-weather months upon us, farmers are usually knee-deep in hay and forage production. If you haven't started to mow your virtual grasslands, it's about time!

Fitting the sunny time of the year, when the grass is the greenest, the Hay & Forage Pack is coming very soon to Farming Simulator 22. When? June 13th for PC and consoles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243170


[h2]17 Machines, 7 Brands, 3 Newcomers![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/9a3fa4898d92b77ce7ba14ee65c59a4274cbb026.jpg[/img]

Time for a bigger garage on your property: 17 brand-new specialized vehicles and tools are included in the Hay & Forage Pack. 

And with those, we welcome three more manufacturers with their brands to the world of Farming Simulator: German mowing specialist Brielmaier and the two Austrian manufacturers REFORM and Reiter join the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/f8776d9269d134ecb1aefb2c50d04a6214d37b50.jpg[/img]

Overall, seven brands are represented in the pack, as KRONE, PÖTTINGER, Rigitrac, and Sepp Knüsel also extend the fleet of machinery. See the complete list of machines below!


[h2]Slope Compensation, Side Shift & More[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/af920b2ff0fd084edda9699c40d8cb9ce33c0e34.jpg[/img]

Each machine, real and virtual, is designed to make your farming-life easier and more fun when operating on vast grasslands or difficult green areas embedded in hilly landscapes. Some of them come with exciting functionality, too!

Enjoy specialized tractors like the REFORM MOUNTY 110V or Rigitrac SKH 60 with its slope-compensating cabin, loading wagons like the modular REFORM PrimAlpin or the PÖTTINGER JUMBO 8450 DB, and mowers like the KRONE Easy Cut F 320 Highland with side shift functionality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/724fe67408b26e6d823773b874d3b4cb5d0733ff.jpg[/img]

On top of that, windrowers shine with ideal ground adjustment on difficult terrain - thanks to the unique design of the Reiter RESPIRO mergers. As you can see, between mowing and unloading at selling-points, the new pack covers all important steps of hay and forage production.

notes.title: New Multiplayer Modes: Arena & Bale Stacking Enter Open Beta!
notes.content:
If you and your friends should come to a dispute - like whose turn it is to harvest the oversized field of wheat with a small combine harvester after someone spend the money for an upgrade on a decadently big tractor - you can now battle it out in new multiplayer modes!

The brand-new Arena Mode and Bale Stacking Mode enter the beta phase in Farming Simulator 22. It's an open beta and available for everyone on PC right now. So, check it out!

 
[h2]Activate "esports" Branch For Competitive Farming![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/e8706e9fc05d5b8dd09f1115d3114ef9c49a6463.jpg[/img]

You have to opt in to the esports branch of Farming Simulator 22, which grants you access to the beta version of our new competitive farming modes. It's only a few clicks, don't worry.

[u][b]Steam version[/b][/u]

[u]Open the Farming Simulator 22 settings via the steam game library, select the "esports" beta branch and confirm.[/u]

After selecting the esports branch, the game will update, and you'll find the "esports" entry in the main menu of Farming Simulator 22. 


[h2]Grab Some Friends Or Battle Strangers![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/b01e61ece9b491b6f1b4f43883eba2050cb7b7d6.jpg[/img]

Whether you play with friends or alone, using the matchmaking, you can now prove your farming skills and strategic abilities. In the Bale Stacking Mode, you compete with others for the highscore of carefully stacked bales.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/4bd7dc8b8d8472818812bce00f871f9c963d07d7.jpg[/img]

If that's not competitive enough for you, enter the arena and compete in a 3 vs. 3 environment against other players. Find out, which team is best at strategically harvesting wheat, pressing bales and delivering them to the own team's barn! 

[previewyoutube=SwEq6zE1bYw;full]{youtube:SwEq6zE1bYw}[/previewyoutube]

[b]Got Beta Feedback?[/b]

You can submit your feedback regarding the new beta game modes via our [url=https://forum.giants-software.com/viewtopic.php?t=168424]public bug tracker[/url]. 


[h2]Want To Go Professional? Join The FSL![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/7e5acde03edfc38857b65a5410a37ba986100c99.jpg[/img]

You probably know the Arena Mode from the [url=https://fsl.giants-software.com/]Farming Simulator League[/url] already. If you're interested in competing on a professional level, check out the website for the FSL, where you and your friends can register and join the league.

notes.title: Bale More, Bale Better! Göweil Pack Now Available
notes.content:
Upgrade your farm with nine new machines by Göweil and extend one of the most fun core activities in the game: baling and wrapping resources. Check out the Launch Trailer!

The Göweil Pack is now available for PC and consoles and lets you put more material into bales, deploy autonomous machines on your farm, and enjoy some cool quality-of-life improvements! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243160/Farming_Simulator_22__Gweil_Pack/

[previewyoutube=LzcafEHBxKs;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Un-bale-lievable Cool Machines For Your Farm[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/a2352fec7b16e3ce22868f8f38f1a216d3b8c0e0.jpg[/img]

With the Göweil Pack, you'll be able to transform even more resources into bales: Corn silage, sugar beet pulp, and mixed feed in addition to grass, hay, and straw. To achieve perfectly pressed bales, there is a variety of cool machines at your disposal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/c05259227890ed88935710b66aa8e20aff41c45f.jpg[/img]

While machines like the Göweil LT-Master F115 or VARIO-Master V140 let you put more resources into bales than before, you can also deploy autonomous machines like the G4010 Q Profi at your farm and benefit from their high efficiency without even moving them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/a8dba3022c05e19200b8a726e4423a15a5f24ce3.jpg[/img]

Meanwhile, roller wrappers like the Göweil G1015 attach to front loaders or three-point hitches and transport, wrap, and stack bales - with only one single machine. In addition, bale turners make your life easier and restrain bales from rolling downhill, optional silage additive tanks raise the bale quality. New bale grippers and bale forks definitely come in handy, too. 


[h2]Machines Included In The Göweil Pack[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/4233015801bb1c1518ffb5987d9193bafcf0c490.jpg[/img]

[h2]About Göweil[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/882ad9157d514467080d2901f5abb8da02838294.jpg[/img]

Austrian manufacturer Göweil has an international reputation for producing high-quality, durable, and innovative machinery - especially baling and wrapping technology. The company was founded in 1988 in Kirchschlag (Upper Austria), where all machines are designed, developed and produced by currently around 250 employees.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243160/Farming_Simulator_22__Gweil_Pack/

While Göweil constantly grows, their machines become more and more popular all around the world. With their debut in the Farming Simulator series, a broad selection of machines and tools adds new possibilities for virtual farmers with a knack for baling. 


[h2]Get The Year 2 Season Pass![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/f072e3c666d9fd9b020641eda2337051fa5ceb19.png[/img]

If you want to extend your copy of the game with loads of new content, check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178810/Farming_Simulator_22__Year_2_Season_Pass/]Year 2 Season Pass[/url]! Especially, since you save money compared to buying the packs and the Platinum expansion separately. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1731910/Farming_Simulator_22__Year_1_Season_Pass/?curator_clanid=40773983]The Year 1 Season Pass[/url] continues to be available separately.

notes.title: Put Corn Silage Into Bales! Göweil Pack Now Available For Pre-Order
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/cb7ef2d45d60df5d542441259254be2d4eb409a0.jpg[/img]

We kick off the second year of Farming Simulator 22 with the Göweil Pack: Nine new machines and tools await and extend one of the most fun core activities in the game: baling and wrapping resources. Put more material into bales, deploy autonomous machines on your farm to create more efficient baling operations, and enjoy some cool quality-of-life improvements!

[b][u][u]The Göweil Pack releases March 21st for PC & consoles. Pre-orders are open. Owners of the Year 2 Season Pass receive the pack on launch day without additional cost.[/u][/u] [/b]

[h2]New Machines & Possibilities[/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/df5570752a3b5886035526325c0fec95a9f98de4.jpg[/img]

With all the new machines from Austrian manufacturer Göweil, like the Göweil LT-Master F115 or VARIO-Master V140, you'll be able to transform even more resources into bales: Corn silage, sugar beet pulp and mixed feed in addition to grass, hay, and straw.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/16e3fc8300a4390aa3f5a582b878e73a6288ad7e.jpg[/img]

If your operation depends on baled resources, you might have fun with deploying autonomous baler-wrappers like the G4010 Q Profi at your farm and benefit from the high efficiency that comes with it. Achieve a high output of bales in variable shapes & sizes directly at your farm! 

[b]Machines included[/b]
[list][*]Göweil LT-Master F115[/*][*]Göweil VARIO-Master V140[/*][*]Göweil G-1 F125[/*][*]Göweil G-1 F125 Kombi[/*][*]Göweil G1015[/*][*]Göweil G4010Q Profi[/*][*]Göweil G5020[/*][*]Göweil RBG[/*][*]Göweil BTGQU[/*][/list][h2]Enhanced Quality-of-Bale-Farming[/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/9e5c275cdf4ee17398effc6f07bf9f5703e39c69.jpg[/img]

There's more: Roller wrappers like the Göweil G1015 attach to front loaders or three-point hitches and transport, wrap, and stack bales - with one single, efficient machine. A small but substantial detail for baling enthusiasts: Net-binding in addition to foil-wrapping will be possible, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/a5726ba7bf42444cd6fdee55fc5a95c49ee04b25.jpg[/img]

And if you're one of the clumsy ones, good news for you: Thanks to the addition of a bale turner, your days of chasing round bales rolling downhill are numbered.

It’s easier to put them into storage, too - thanks to new bale grippers and bale forks like the Göweil RBG and BTGQU. Even the quality of bales rises with optional silage additive tanks for baler wrapper combinations like the Göweil G-1 F125 Kombi. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243160/Farming_Simulator_22__Gweil_Pack/?beta=0


[h2]About Göweil[/h2]

Austrian manufacturer Göweil has an international reputation for producing high-quality, durable, and innovative machinery - especially baling and wrapping technology. The company was founded in 1988 in Kirchschlag (Upper Austria), where all machines are designed, developed and produced by currently around 250 employees.

While Göweil constantly grows, their machines become more and more popular all around the world. With their debut in the Farming Simulator series, a broad selection of machines and tools adds new possibilities for virtual farmers with a knack for baling. 


[h2][u]Get The Year 2 Season Pass![/u][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178810/Farming_Simulator_22__Year_2_Season_Pass/

[u]If you want to extend your copy of the game with loads of new content, check out the [/u][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178810/Farming_Simulator_22__Year_2_Season_Pass/][u]Year 2 Season Pass[/u][/url][u][u]! [/u][u]Especially, since you save money compared to buying the packs and the Platinum expansion separately. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1731910/Farming_Simulator_22__Year_1_Season_Pass/]The Year 1 Season Pass[/url] continues to be available separately. [/u][/u]

notes.title: Platinum Patch 1.3 Now Available!
notes.content:
There's a new patch available for the Platinum Expansion & Edition of Farming Simulator 22! With the Wood-Mizer LT15 CLASSIC, a new sawmill becomes available to be placed on your land. Take a look: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/50d2a14ffff43951dcade283004f989c5233e8ce.jpg[/img]

Also, the mineshaft from Silverrun Forest, the new map included in the Platinum Expansion, can now be placed on other maps, too. As always, various optimizations are included in the patch - find them below!



[h2]Changelog for Platinum Patch 1.3[/h2]

Please Note! As with all major updates to Farming Simulator, you may experience stuttering on the first game launch after updating. Especially when using mods or custom graphics settings due to shaders being recompiled.

[h3]New Additions[/h3]

[list]
[*] new placable sawmill with Wood-Mizer LT15 CLASSIC
[*] mineshaft now also available as placeable on other maps
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes & Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] fixed indoor camera of Manitou M504
[*] added new draw bar for Pfanzelt P13 including hydraulic hoses
[*] improved driving behavior of Volvo trucks
[*] improved arm controls of Volvo L200H & Impex Hannibal T50
[*] fixed collisions and weight of Lodgepole Pines
[*] fixed issues with pallets and trailer fill limit setting
[*] fixed automatic arm alignment of Volvo EC380DL
[*] fixed issues with grapples getting stuck and won't close anymore
[*] fixed grabbing small logs with the Pfanzelt PmTrac
[*] fixed winch rope not attached to the roll on Tajfun EGV 65
[*] fixed PTO attaching on the Kotschenreuther K300R
[*] increased reward for deadwood
[*] reduced spray levels to 2 as on the other maps
[*] improved grapple of the L200H, so it won't get stuck in a weird position
[*] wood chip selling stations now accept poplar bales as well
[*] various visual fixes on the vehicles
[/list]
Get The Season Pass!

If you want to extend your copy of the game with loads of new content, check out the Season Pass! Especially, since you save money compared to buying the packs and the Platinum expansion separately.

notes.title: Platinum Preview: Collectibles & Points of Interest in Silverrun Forest
notes.content:
Your journey to and within Silverrun Forest is about to begin. With the Platinum Expansion and Platinum Edition releasing in a few days' time, on November 15th, there will be a lot of new content to explore - just like the new map itself with its points of interest. Let's check out some of them!

If you missed our previous news about new gameplay features and machines, you find all the previews in the list below.
[list][*][url=https://www.farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=417]Platinum Preview: Tree Marking Sprays & Signs[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=418]Platinum Preview: Hydraulic Breaking[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=419]Platinum Preview: Log Transport feat. Yarders, Winches & Containers[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=420]Platinum Preview: Improved Planting & Harvesting[/url][/*][/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024410/Farming_Simulator_22__Platinum_Expansion/


[h2]Welcome to the Woods of Silverrun Forest![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/ac0636f0423b2b436c0a3beb1176426cdf85f629.jpg[/img]

Silverrun Forest consists of vast forests on hilly and sometimes challenging terrain - making it the most atmospheric and lush environment we did so far. Not only is Silverrun Forest populated by more than 20,000 trees - countless streams wind themselves through the forest and over ridges of the mountainous landscape.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/RCOMZ0bh.gif[/img]

Small ponds and lakes right in the middle of dense forests create serene spots to relax and to explore. It's especially atmospheric since our environment artists upgraded the seasonal visuals of Silverrun Forest, with the colors of grass and bushes changing more authentically than before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/ac0e9ce08e16daf62353be353bbcade9662984c6.jpg[/img]

Even in the village, the four seasons will be more present: With autumn leaves waving through the streets and tiny puddles appearing on the roads on rainy days. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Zt3Mt9jh.gif[/img]

There's a lot more to explore, namely the new collectibles we've hidden in the forests. Before we get to that, let's stay in town and take a look at what we find here on the business side of things. 


[h2]Production Sites In Silverrun Forest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/5e49805c48b38616c08e95ae26e08e750bdc2eee.jpg[/img]

New selling points and production sites revolve mostly around harvested resources from the woods. We already took a deeper look into new production chains and [url=https://www.farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=427]construction projects - especially the rollercoaster and the boatyard.[/url] But, let's take a peek at some other businesses and points of interest in Silverrun Forest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/8dd2d764366bf28f8d6d7ef3e684ad66025a2e45.jpg[/img]

The iron ore mine will automatically produce iron, you can load up and process into metal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/9868befc020d025fcd57d5250357ace35fe9b771.jpg[/img]

At the pet accessories factory, you can produce new types of products to sell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/d73874e80f06255fffe8bb66b607b0db120486c9.jpg[/img]

There are two saw mills. This one is especially fun as you unload logs into the water, which are then pulled in and processed. 


[h2]Selling Points In Silverrun Forest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/82755a13b7dee4c7c1fab25650d9a46d738ecaf5.jpg[/img]

Of course, there are the usual places to go. Like the gas station, the dealership, or the train station. One of the most important selling points in Silverrun Forest is the market. You can sell almost anything here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/d31941ce9895e95397398990552c77de8e7cde56.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Platinum-Ready, XeSS Support, Improved AI: Patch 1.8.1 Now Available!
notes.content:
We're only days away from releasing the Platinum Expansion for Farming Simulator 22. Patch 1.8.1 is now available to download and makes the game ready for all those new features, machines, and improvements.

On top of that, we included Intel XeSS support, improved the AI and added a plethora of other optimizations. Start downloading and check it out!


[h2]Ready to Harvest With Platinum![/h2]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024410/Farming_Simulator_22__Platinum_Expansion/]Platinum Expansion[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/744038/]Platinum Edition[/url] (base game + expansion) release on November 15th for PC, Mac, PlayStation®5 (PS5™), Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation®4 and Xbox One. Make sure you install patch 1.8.1 to make the expansion run and be able to operate all the 40+ machines included in the expansion!

Not only is the patch preparing the game for Platinum, it brings various optimizations. Including general performance improvements as well as an improved AI behavior in certain situations. You can also enjoy new options to define variable lengths for wood harvester cutting, and more.

To make the entry into the series a bit more beginner-friendly, we also revised the entire help section in the game. Find the complete changelog below!


[h2]More Frames With Intel: Adding XeSS[/h2]

Intel XeSS (Xe Super Sampling) is an upscaling feature of Intel Arc Alchemist graphics cards. Similar to [url=https://www.farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=278]NVIDIAs DLSS[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lHFgsSYSN-c]AMDs FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR)[/url], it renders Farming Simulator 22 at a lower resolution and then upscales it using machine learning and dedicated AI hardware of the GPU. The result: improved performance while maintaining high image quality. Find out more about [url=https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/docs/arc-discrete-graphics/xess.html]Intel XeSS[/url] on Intel.com! 


[h2]Welcome HELM to Farming Simulator![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/b80c55d34e404402614501b296550b8d93976724.png[/img]

We're proud to welcome [url=https://www.helmag.com/]HELM[/url] to Farming Simulator 22 with new fertilizer and herbicide available in the "objects" category of the virtual dealership where you find big bags to fill your spreaders and sprayers.

The family-owned company from Hamburg, Germany specializes in chemicals, crop protection, fertilizers, and pharmaceuticals. With more than 100 subsidiaries in over 30 countries, it's one of the leading enterprises in major markets worldwide.

notes.title: Platinum Preview: Improved Planting & Harvesting
notes.content:
We're coming closer to the launch of the Platinum Expansion for Farming Simulator 22 on November 15th. We're not done looking at new features, that are about to be introduced to the series. Did you miss the latest news? Don't worry, and take some time to catch up:
[list][*][url=https://farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=417]Platinum Preview: Tree Marking Sprays & Signs[/url][/*][*][url=https://farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=418]Platinum Preview: Hydraulic Breaking[/url][/*][*][url=https://farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=419]Platinum Preview: Log Transport feat. Yarders, Winches & Containers[/url][/*][/list]
Today, we want to show you some of the improvements we made in regard to planting and harvesting trees - of course, there are new machines that bring some cool functionality. Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024410/Farming_Simulator_22__Platinum_Expansion/


[h2]New Tree Species In Silverrun Forest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/8d56a032f082589ab683fc5495a90791d313314b.jpg[/img]

More than 20,000 trees are already planted in Silverrun forest, our new map, when you arrive. Some of them are new to the game: We're adding more coniferous trees to the [url=https://farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=367]existing tree species in Farming Simulator 22[/url]. 

At the dealership, you find a new, bigger pallet of saplings (240 pieces) that includes the configuration option for the new tree types.
[list][*][b]The Ponderosa Pine (Pinus ponderosa)[/b] is a rather large pine, native to the mountainous regions of western North America. Not only that, it's the most widely distributed pine species in North America. It's used for building material and firewood.[/*][*][b]The Lodgepole Pine (Pinus contorta)[/b] is also very common in western North America, especially near the ocean shore. This evergreen conifer is often used in rural areas for log cabins, posts, fences, lumber, and firewood. In some parts of the world, it's also popular for reforestation purposes. [/*][*][b]The Sequoia (Sequoioideae)[/b], also known as "redwoods", are coniferous trees from a family of trees which includes the largest and tallest on our planet. They're endangered and have been cultivated beyond their native habitats. They are not supposed to be chopped down but a great choice for reforestation. [/*][/list]

[h2]Planting More Trees Than Ever[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/c2b08a99c1f8ada194d20819837c66b09719a204.jpg[/img]

There are multiple machines to use for planting and harvesting trees. More than 40 new vehicles and tools are included in the expansion - featuring John Deere, Komatsu, Pfanzelt, Koller, Schwarzmüller, IMPEX and other brands.

If you want more details about the individual machines, take a look at our [url=https://farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=416]Platinum Fact Sheet Collection[/url]! We update it every Friday upon release and add more machines with their specifications. Let's look at planting and harvesting, now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/4f7c42ff0550b7af9fde72553aa3e2eb142a7725.jpg[/img]

One of the debutants to the series is Volvo Group that bring machines for planting and harvesting with them: the Volvo EC250DL and its big brother, the Volvo EC380DL. Alongside many other machines, of course. Both of them become machines of choice if you want to plant trees like crazy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/e0f6176c7567de9fae4f8115b1013641f5eef1cf.jpg[/img]

If you're into planting trees, you'll like the Risutec SKB-240, too - allowing you to plant no less than 240 saplings in one go in combination with the above-mentioned Volvo machines. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/056mGLj.gif[/img]

You have to buy the big pallet of saplings that includes the new tree species shown above to fill the tool. Also, it does look cool, doesn't it?


[h2]Time To Harvest Some Trees[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/0f704766212c1fc6ebc335804603367bc7558d35.jpg[/img]

Let's continue with the new harvesting equipment and take a look at some of the new machines in the category. While the Volvo EC250DL allows you to attach a processor head, the Koller P60, to lop off branches and cut the tree into logs, the EC380DL can be combined with a high-performance harvester head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/7773e2b3b57b2377419226d888cdcda8cdd939e9.jpg[/img]

Among many other configurations and attachments, you can also attach a feller buncher to both of them, to harvest and transport multiple logs at once. On top of all those fun playthings, we added some new functionality, too.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O9va0gG.gif[/img]

See, how flexible the movement of the harvester head is? To make the control of harvester heads a bit more agile, you can now tilt the head of your harvester to not only cut trees but grab them from the ground. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bqvIafK.gif[/img]

Grabbing a tree automatically is also easier now. A yellow ring appears around the tree stump in immediate proximity, so you always know which tree you are currently aiming at in the dense woods of Silverrun Forest. As soon as it turns green, the harvester is ready for action.

If you want to grab more than one tree - you can. With the John Deere Feller Buncher 843L-II + the FD55 disc saw felling head. Take a look at that beast:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/c2552c7f7eb0c20c82d0af2ac3f50cdf5c0870db.jpg[/img]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024410/Farming_Simulator_22__Platinum_Expansion/]Platinum Expansion[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/744038/]Platinum Edition[/url] (base game + expansion) release on November 15th for PC, Mac, PlayStation®5 (PS5™), Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation®4 and Xbox One.

If you want to extend your copy of the game with loads of new content, check out the [url=https://farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=256]Season Pass[/url] Especially, since you save money compared to buying the packs and the upcoming Platinum expansion separately.

notes.title: Platinum Preview Log Transport feat. Yarders, Winches & Containers
notes.content:
One of the many reasons why forestry is such fun is the logistics. With the upcoming Platinum Expansion for Farming Simulator 22, forestry and the options for transporting logs are getting an upgrade. Let's take a look at the means of transportation when playing in the woods of Silverrun Forest.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024410/Farming_Simulator_22__Platinum_Expansion/


[h2]Drag Your Logs With Winches[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/c93bc317c28adaa91d1084a8664646f3ca791940.jpg[/img]

Moving long logs of chopped-down trees through the forest and maneuvering them between other trees can be a hassle. That's where winches come into play. They exist in two forms: as attachments for your regular tractors or so-called multipurpose tractors like the Pfanzelt Pm Trac - a specialized form of tractor that is ready to go when you need to move logs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/e4833fd19b2231034b8feec91291b858de93885f.jpg[/img]

Forestry winches are contraptions designed to pull heavy logs with the use of wire ropes. In Farming Simulator 22, you simply attach the rope of your chosen winch to one or multiple logs and pull them with your vehicle to a more spacious collection point. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/d0551ff65fcdee708428e3dcabe6dfaa90533921.jpg[/img]

Up to ten logs can be dragged across the forest with some winches, as two logs can be inserted into the implement directly. But beware, that only works with long and heavy logs, and driving too fast may result in losing them on your way. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/9a07c75fe4a7c15a3e9ed6991df387e05496c725.jpg[/img]

Good thing, the Pfanzelt Felix and Pm Trac come with a clam bunk. So you can pick them up again in case you lost them on your way.


[h2]Bypass Rough Terrain With Yarders[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/5bf5ffeb07898085b220516307ddd13b4ddac8f2.jpg[/img]

Yarders are a fun piece of logging equipment. With the Platinum Expansion, we introduce two different kinds of yarders: the Koller K-300-T and the Koller K 307c-H.

They are used to bypass hilly or otherwise impassable terrain and transport logs out of the dense woods by using a system of cables to pull logs from their stump to a collection point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/aceb617076f6f96c7cf480c52cc6770ae8841736.jpg[/img]

In Silverrun Forest, you find some paths that may lead you to places that can serve as said collection points (or you just create your own where you want it). You can move logs via yarders up or downhill. 

The Koller K-300-T can only drag your logs upwards over a span of 500 meters (1,650 ft) - the collection point must be above the area where you harvest. The Koller K 307c-H is more flexible and can move both ways. It also spans 840 meters (2750 ft).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/f9cb57e733fac2a4b14ec105d0301eb1f1bba52b.jpg[/img]

Place the yarder at your chosen collection point and grab a rope from the implement. With the rope "in hand", you move to the location in the forest, where you want to harvest trees. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/50ab824a812caf8ceb985da2fd28a08c7aa86471.jpg[/img]

Find a sturdy tree to attach the rope to. If you aim at a suitable tree, it is indicated that you can attach the other end of the rope to it. Now, you have a straight line of rope that spans between the collection point and the harvesting area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/15e7d72634da88b714cd9760e8bd0d03c408287c.jpg[/img]

Now you can see the carriage appearing that you connect to cut logs. You can send the carriage on its way or make it follow you, so it's always right behind you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/598d6d80b2934a359ce0afcbf4b8ace696c410a9.jpg[/img]

Attach a cut log from the harvesting area to the carriage by grabbing a rope.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/6280df69f3072a8fbc3b81cbce9a39a7eb159119.jpg[/img]

If attached, you can send the carriage on its way - or make it follow you if you're on your way to the collection point anyway. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024410/Farming_Simulator_22__Platinum_Expansion/


[h2]Fill Your Containers![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/65dfb1fbd8b719aa325e945bdcaaa799d8826cc2.jpg[/img]

Yay, containers! To ship your carefully harvested logs in high quantities, you can now use shipping containers. Use them to transport and sell them. They come in three different sizes: 12 meters (40 ft), 9 meters (30 ft) and 6 meters (20 ft) long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/5247b51b316e8322c1b866ca8b69afa8da6929d2.jpg[/img]

Using an excavator like the Volvo EC250DL, EC380DL or other heavy machinery, you load them up by lifting the logs and driving them to the opened side of the container.

Make sure, they fit the size of the container. The length of the logs should be as close as possible to the length of the container. Too long, they won't fit. Too short, you will gain less money. So, don't you waste that precious space in those containers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/a86953592ab5e7c34d55b495e67051d9ded6bf59.jpg[/img]

Using a wheel loader like the Volvo L180H with a pallet fork attachment, you can unload the shipping containers in the designated area of a factory or load them onto the train to sell them.

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024410/Farming_Simulator_22__Platinum_Expansion/]Platinum Expansion[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/744038/]Platinum Edition[/url] (base game + expansion) release on November 15th for PC, Mac, PlayStation®5 (PS5™), Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation®4 and Xbox One.

notes.title: Platinum Preview: Tree Marking Sprays & Signs
notes.content:
Shake your spray cans and go to the forest! We're looking at the new tree marking system introduced with the Platinum Expansion for Farming Simulator 22. Since we're not far away from the release of our heavy expansion on November 15th, we'll take a closer look at some features over the course of the following weeks.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2024410/Farming_Simulator_22__Platinum_Expansion/


[h2]Why Mark Trees?[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/46966fad513c236be0c7d68f6e2c0c2a1c8a36fb.jpg[/img]

Spray cans in various colors allow you to mark trees with a set of signs, so you and your friends know what to do. Let's take a look at the colors and symbols and what they mean.

In deadwood missions, a new type of contract coming with the Platinum Expansion, trees supposed to be removed, are already marked. Fell only the marked trees - otherwise, you get a penalty for removing healthy trees!

[b]Please note:[/b] Since the meaning of tree markings is not universal and differs internationally, you might disagree with the use of colors and signs described here. That's okay - since you can use the colors and symbols as you see fit. If you want to use them in accordance with the local preferences in your neck of the woods, you can look them up by searching the internet with queries based on your location.


[h2]Tree Marking Spray[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/4caf466ce074821dc341602039b6bf17cd222816.jpg[/img]

At the virtual dealership, you find spray cans in different colors. Gameplay-wise, you can use any color. Choose your favorite, if you want. In reality, though, they're usually associated with specific actions or purposes after felling the tree.

Red or white is used in many regions when it comes to harvesting timber, forwarding within the forest and selling harvested logs.  Blue or orange on the other hand are often traffic-related or used to mark logs that are to be destined for firewood. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/4684a0419752c982624121c8733f1ca3381bac97.jpg[/img]

Buy spray cans at the dealership in the "tools" section. You find various colors of tree marking spray in its own category. You equip it just like the chainsaw, either pressing the assigned key to swap inventory items or use the mouse wheel. You can switch the signs by pressing the respectively assigned keys, point at the tree and press the button to apply the chosen symbol. 


[h2]Tree Marking Signs[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/3eb66e8b33783b96b4ece3cd2d5029d1da16195e.jpg[/img]

[list][*][b]Logging trail:[/b] Marking trees with two horizontal, parallel lines indicates that you are on a trail where machines move to the actual logging location.[/*][*][b]Remove tree:[/b] Trees marked with the "backslash" are supposed to be removed.[/*][*][b]Support tree[/b]: Trees marked with the circle are not supposed to be chopped down, but supported. Meaning, leave him (and his friends) alone, or plant new trees in the vicinity.[/*][*][b]Saw off at this height [/b]is indicated by a horizontal line with an arrow facing down. [/*][*][b]Deadwood[/b] is indicated with an exclamation mark. You will see this when taking on deadwood missions. They are to be removed.[/*][*][b]X[/b] can have various meanings. Often, it just marks trees should be removed for whatever reason. Feel free to assign any meaning to this mark. [/*][/list]
As mentioned above, a lot of symbols are not universally recognized, but their meaning differs internationally. Neither colors nor symbols follow a strict code, but are merely local or a forest ranger's personal preferences. 

While the "X" often just means "this tree is marked to be removed" for whatever reason, in some parts of the world it is only applied to hazardous trees (deadwood) that pose a threat to nearby trees. Or it means whatever the forest ranger says it means. If you're new to forestry, you can work with the signs and meanings in the graphic above, or use them just like you prefer. 


[h2][u]Get The Season Pass![/u][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/edcce5f2578ce3759c9b717b3d0ad3ece85be237.jpg[/img]

[u]If you want to extend your copy of the game with loads of new content, check out the [/u][url=newsArticle.php?&news_id=256][u]Season Pass[/u][/url][u][u]! [/u][u]Especially, since you save money compared to buying the packs and the upcoming Platinum expansion separately. [/u][/u]

notes.title: Now Available: Pumps N' Hoses - Third-Party Pack by Creative Mesh
notes.content:
Start pumping! Developed by Creative Mesh and published by GIANTS Software, the Pumps N' Hoses Pack is now available for Farming Simulator 22. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052720/Farming_Simulator_22__Pumps_n_Hoses_Pack/

Implement umbilical systems on your farm, configure your own biogas plants, and do what needs to be done on behalf of efficiency: separate manure! It's really more about pumps and hoses, though. Check the launch trailer to pump yourself up a bit!

[previewyoutube=fHdeniSi1nI;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Third-Party Pack Adds New Gameplay Features[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/ad72c6f40d5c0ba87397d82f41168edfe7515249.jpg[/img]

Pumps N' Hoses implements three new components to deepen the gameplay of virtual farming: Umbilical systems, manure separation, and biogas plant configuration add never-seen gameplay features to the series. New brands, machines, and tools? Sure, all in there as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/16613e8f4541d7ad478a6cb4bb3ca67eb9955fe9.jpg[/img]

Let's talk numbers: Included in Pumps N' Hoses are more than 40 new items. Dutch manufacturer Schouten, German steel storage specialist Stallkamp, biogas feeding technology manufacturer BvL and 2G Energy are represented and push the number of brands available in Farming Simulator 22 beyond 150. 


[h2]Support Creative Mesh - Get Pumps N' Hoses![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/ed7e83f2c02dd4162acdaa8834707724d2481b5f.jpg[/img]

While Pumps N' Hoses is published by us, GIANTS Software, it's Creative Mesh who deserves the credit: As the team is pushing itself to develop large-scale products, you can support the former modders by purchasing Pumps N' Hoses on our official website store - or wherever you get your additional content for Farming Simulator 22.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052720/Farming_Simulator_22__Pumps_n_Hoses_Pack/

[url=https://www.creative-mesh.com/]Creative Mesh[/url] was founded in 2016 by some members of "bm-modding", which have been active in the Farming Simulator community since 2011. They created many acclaimed mods for several installments of the Farming Simulator series and won the official Farming Simulator mod contest in 2015.

For Farming Simulator 17 and 19, Creative Mesh developed the[url=newsArticle.php?&news_id=141] Straw Harvest Expansion[/url], focussing on straw baling, pelletizing and all the different equipment around it.

notes.title: Pumps N' Hoses - Third-Party Pack by Creative Mesh Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Soon you can upgrade your farming operation with umbilical systems, manure separation and configurable biogas plants! Creative Mesh, best known for Straw Harvest, is currently working on Pumps N' Hoses - a third-party pack for Farming Simulator 22. Available on September 27th for PC and consoles!


[h2]New gameplay features, machines, tools & buildings[/h2]

A huge variety of new machines, tools and buildings extend the infrastructure of manure distribution and resource storage on your farm. More than 30 items from Dutch manufacturer Schouten, German steel storage specialist Stallkamp and biogas technology manufacturer BvL are included in Pumps N' Hoses. The pack consists of basically three components  to introduce new gameplay features - learn more below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052720/Farming_Simulator_22__Pumps_n_Hoses_Pack


[h2]Umbilical Systems [/h2]

Pumps N' Hoses lets you implement so-called umbilical systems on your farm: By attaching draggable hoses in different lengths and ultra-light drag hose injectors instead of heavy manure tanks to your tractor, you protect the soil and fertilize your fields.

That's convenient because of the high capacities of mobile pumping units (wagons and trailers) stationed nearby. You'll  be able to combine hoses that span hundreds of meters to cover your fields for efficient fertilization. To improve pumping conditions, additional water tanks and compressors are also available.

 
[h2]Manure Separation[/h2]

Liquid manure separators will allow you to separate liquid and solid components of manure. Why? For a more versatile application! Multiple stationary and mobile separators will be available at the dealership in-game.

Do you want to use the dry parts of manure for animal bedding on your dairy farm, sell it for a profit, or fertilize your fields with it? That's your choice. 


[h2]Biogas Plant Configuration[/h2]

Fans of biogas plants, can look forward to upgrading them by configuring the plants according to their needs and preferences: Various modules can be dynamically placed around the root facility.

You decide where to build reception areas, fermentation tanks, gas holders, power plants to produce electricity and other components in various sizes. A gas torch to burn excess gasses of your high-performing biogas plant is also available. 


[h2]Pre-Order Now And Support Creative Mesh![/h2]

Presented and published by GIANTS Software, Pumps N' Hoses is made by Creative Mesh. By pre-ordering and purchasing the third-party pack for Farming Simulator 22, you can support the mod-team that grew into a development studio directly. 

Pumps N' Hoses will be available on September 27th for PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X/S and Xbox One.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052720/Farming_Simulator_22__Pumps_n_Hoses_Pack


[h2]About Creative Mesh[/h2]
[url=https://www.creative-mesh.com/]Creative Mesh[/url] was founded in 2016 by some members of "bm-modding", which have been active in the Farming Simulator community since 2011. They created many acclaimed mods for several installments of the Farming Simulator series and won the official Farming Simulator mod contest in 2015. For Farming Simulator 17 and 19, Creative Mesh developed the[url=https://www.farming-simulator.com/newsArticle.php?news_id=141] Straw Harvest Expansion[/url], focussing on the pellet industry.

notes.title: Vermeer Pack For Farming Simulator 22 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Vermeer, inventor of the round baler as you know it, is soon joining Farming Simulator 22. The upcoming Vermeer Pack, included in the Year 1 Season Pass, will be available on August 23rd for PC and consoles. Among the new machines is the world's first self-propelled baler - find out more below, and don't forget to pre-order!

[previewyoutube=PcJRIDCPbgU;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992250/Farming_Simulator_22__Vermeer_Pack/


[h2]New Machines From Industry Pioneers[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773983/279e18d1ceb885072eb185652457ff48fd15964c.jpg[/img]

Baling will get a lot more efficient thanks to the Vermeer ZR5-1200, a self-propelled baler (and the first of its kind). Press bales as fast as possible, with great comfort and maneuverability - but without the necessity of a tractor. It's especially easy to use thanks to the zero-turn capability and high transport speeds. That will save you a lot of time on and between fields.
